sketches.mechanism: Goroutine launched with no channel to receive from — the main function exits before the goroutine can speak
sketches.resonance: The goroutine has something to say but the program ends before anyone listens, mirroring words spoken into absence.

sketches.mechanism: The 'never' return type — a function typed to never return, containing an infinite loop of waiting
sketches.resonance: A promise that resolves to 'never' is a commitment to remain forever unfinished, a vigil without conclusion.

sketches.mechanism: Weak table references — when a value is only held in a weak table, it can be garbage collected at any time, as if it was never held at all
sketches.resonance: A weak reference is the language's way of holding something without claiming it — love that cannot prevent loss.
sketches.draft:
held = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "v" })

do
  local you = {}
  held[1] = you
end

collectgarbage()
-- held[1] is nil
